name: Cenomi
verdict: Cenomi Centers, a Saudi-listed shopping-centre developer; its largest shareholder and immediate parent is FAS Real Estate Company Limited (26.89% at 31 December 2025), and its ultimate parent is Saudi FAS Holding Company. Nothing found.
note: Al-Ahli partner since December 2024; the Cenomi logo appears on the back of the first team's jersey under the partnership extended to 2031.
